description:
Hi! I'm Inam Ullah, a Computer Science student at Riphah International University, Malakand Campus, Pakistan. I'm interested in web development, UI/UX design, software engineering, and space exploration.

I'm the creator of LunarBase – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer under iWi Ternary Lab.

My skills include HTML, CSS, JavaScript, C++, Java, and UI/UX design. I'm looking for motivated people interested in programming, design, astronomy, and research.

Let's connect, collaborate, and innovate
